description: Source code for JsonAssetLoader class handling JSON parsing and asset extraction for ClearKey DRM in Android.

classes.name: JsonAssetLoader
classes.description: Handles parsing JSON strings to extract DRM license assets and decode base64 strings.

methods.name: extractAssetFromString
methods.description: Extracts a clear key asset from a JSON string, returning status.

methods.name: decodeBase64String
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string into a buffer.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Finds and sets key attributes in an asset from a JSON object string.

methods.name: findValue
methods.description: Finds the value associated with a key in tokenized JSON data.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON object string into tokens.

methods.name: parseJsonAssetString
methods.description: Parses a JSON asset string into JSON objects.
